subject: Problem after compiling and installing - fmesher.static: not found (inla.static also not found)

messages.author: fc954eac9a2f8212
messages.subject: Problem after compiling and installing - fmesher.static: not found (inla.static also not found)
parts:
Hello,

I downloaded the inla source and compiled it following the instructions in

r-inla/build-user/linux/Makefile

I got a helpful message telling me how to install the package

R --vanilla CMD INSTALL /path/to/r-inla/build-user/linux/tmp/RINLA/INLA_0.0-1495729373.tgz

and installation seemed to work. However upon using INLA I got error messages - first that fmesher.static was not found, and then that inla.static was not found.

In both cases I think I resolved it by simply making a symlink from INLA_INSTALL_DIR/bin/linux/64bit/fmesher.run to ...fmesher.static

At the very least, the code ran. I'm running the output passed a more experienced dev to determine if it looks correct.

I'm curious - is this a correct resolution? If so, can anyone point me to what I may have done wrong such that this doesn't automatically happen?

Thank you very much,

Mike

messages.author: afb003e064114795
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] Problem after compiling and installing - fmesher.static: not found (inla.static also not found)
parts:
Hi,
I believe that Makefile has lagged behind the general package build development, so that it installs the binaries under different names than the R code expects. I'll try to fix it!

Finn
